# p10k-rs v0.1.0

First tagged release of `p10k-rs` — the Rust port and spiritual successor to
[Powerlevel10k](https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k). Single static
binary, declarative TOML config, multi-shell prompt, `gitstatusd`-class git
latency.

## What's in v0.1.0

**All 21 MVP segments** from `MVP-SPEC.md` § 1.2 are wired and configurable:

- *Always-on*: `dir`, `prompt_char`, `status`, `command_execution_time`,
  `background_jobs`, `time`, `context`, `vi_mode`, `root_indicator`, `vcs`
- *Auto-detected*: `virtualenv`, `anaconda`, `pyenv`, `nodenv`,
  `kubecontext`, `terraform`, `aws`, `os_icon`
- *Version-bundled*: `node_version`, `python_version`, `rust_version`

**Per-segment styling** via TOML:

```toml
[segment.dir]
foreground = "cyan"

[segment.vcs.states.dirty]
foreground = "magenta"
```

Three colour modes (8-color / 256-color / truecolor) with 16
Powerlevel9k-compatible named colours, plus indexed (`0`–`255`) and RGB
triplets / `#rrggbb` hex.

**Multi-shell support**:

- `eval "$(p10k-rs init zsh)"` — full feature set including the
  long-lived `gitstatusd` daemon backend and instant prompt.
- `eval "$(p10k-rs init bash)"` — no daemon, no timing, no instant prompt.
- `p10k-rs init fish | source` — no daemon, no instant prompt, but with
  command-execution-time tracking via `fish_preexec`.

**Powerlevel10k importer**:

```bash
p10k-rs import ~/.p10k.zsh > ~/.config/p10k-rs/config.toml
```

Best-effort textual translation (never executes the input). Handles the
layout arrays, mode, instant-prompt mode, per-segment + per-state
foreground / background. Unrecognised variables are reported on stderr.

**Configure wizard**:

```bash
p10k-rs configure > ~/.config/p10k-rs/config.toml
```

Three-question Q&A: style preset (lean / classic / minimal), glyph mode,
colour palette. The 30-screen raw-mode TUI from
`06-wizard-and-presets.md` is a v0.2 conversation.

## Install

One line — clones the repo to `~/.local/share/powerlevel10k-rs`, builds
the binary, wires zsh:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs/main/get.sh | bash
```

Or download a prebuilt binary tarball from this release for your platform:

- `p10k-rs-0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`
- `p10k-rs-0.1.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`
- `p10k-rs-0.1.0-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz`
- `p10k-rs-0.1.0-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz`

Each tarball ships the binary, `LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`,
`README.md`, and `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md`. A `.sha256` companion file
holds the integrity hash.

To extract and install manually:

```bash
tar xzf p10k-rs-0.1.0-<target>.tar.gz
sudo mv p10k-rs-0.1.0-<target>/p10k-rs /usr/local/bin/
echo 'eval "$(p10k-rs init zsh)"' >> ~/.zshrc
```

## Quality

- 198 tests pass workspace-wide.
- All five gates green: `cargo build`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`,
  `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`,
  `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo doc --no-deps --workspace --locked`.
- Render-path sanitisation enforced via the `SafeText` newtype — branch
  names, cwds, and other untrusted strings can't carry ANSI escapes or
  zsh `%`-expansion attacks into the prompt.
- One unit test (`node_version::walk_returns_false_when_missing`) is
  `#[ignore]`d to avoid environmental pollution from stray
  `/tmp/package.json` files. Run with `--ignored` on a clean `/tmp`.

## Known gaps for v0.1.0

- **Right-side prompt** (`RPROMPT`) not yet rendered — schema accepts
  it, render path doesn't emit it.
- **Transient prompt** (collapse on accept-line) not yet wired.
- **Subsegment colours** (e.g. the `vcs` dirty marker) stay hardcoded —
  single-fg-per-state config can't distinguish branch from marker.
- **Version segments spawn subprocesses per prompt** when their cwd
  marker is present. A caching layer / daemon-side cache is on the
  v0.2 list.
- **`vi_mode`** reads `$P10K_RS_VI_MODE` directly; the zsh
  `zle-keymap-select` plumbing that exports it lands in a follow-up
  slice.
- **`kubecontext`** uses a hand-rolled one-line YAML scanner; edge
  cases (anchors, multi-line, in-string `current-context:`) aren't
  covered. Swap to a proper YAML dep if a real config breaks.
- **Wizard** is a stdin Q&A flow, not the rich TUI; full preset
  catalogue is a v0.2 slice.

## Architecture decisions

- **ADR-0001**: `gitstatusd` over FIFOs is the production hot path.
  The day-1 latency spike against `gix-status` informed this. zsh-only
  for now; the bash/fish init scripts fall back to the `git`-shell-out
  backend.
- **MVP is single-threaded synchronous** (no `tokio`, no async).
  Spawn-per-prompt; the daemon-side parallelism conversation is v0.2.
